coverageGaps: Did not analyze the full packages/surveys or packages/survey-ui bundles (compiled UMD — not user-facing routing).
Backend API routes under apps/web/app/api/ were not catalogued — only user-facing pages were scanned.
No explicit font-family declaration found in the web app's CSS or layout; the product likely inherits the Tailwind v4 default sans stack (no custom font token extracted).
Enterprise-edition modules (ee/) were sampled but not exhaustively scanned — RBAC, SSO config, and advanced billing internals not fully traced.
Workspace-level integrations (Slack, Notion, Airtable, Google Sheets) were noted as routes but the per-integration flows were not deeply mapped.
The docs site (apps/docs) was not analyzed — it has its own Mintlify-based framework.
notes: Formbricks uses Better Auth (migrated from NextAuth) for authentication with support for email/password, Google, GitHub, Azure, OIDC, and SAML SSO. The i18n system uses Lingo.dev with en-US.json as the source of truth. The product has three plan tiers on cloud: Hobby (free), Pro, and Scale with A/B tested onboarding copy for trial conversion. The survey-ui package compiles to a UMD bundle served from public/js for embedding surveys in customer sites.
oneLineDescription: An open-source experience management platform for creating surveys, collecting feedback, and analyzing responses across web and app channels.

interventions.content: Try signing up with Google or GitHub — it's one click and skips the password step entirely.
interventions.goal: Reduce perceived cost of identifying by surfacing the OAuth shortcut.

interventions.content: That password was found in a public breach. Try a passphrase like three random words joined together — easy to remember, hard to crack.
interventions.goal: Help user create a valid password on the next attempt.

interventions.content: Didn't get the verification email? Check your spam folder, or reply to this email and we'll sort it out.
interventions.goal: Recover users who stall at the email verification wall.

risks.label: Password requirements or company-email restriction frustrates user
risks.signal: Form field abandonment; field dwell > 20s without submit

risks.label: HIBP breach check rejects chosen password
risks.signal: Error toast: 'This password has appeared in a data breach'

risks.label: User doesn't receive verification email or doesn't check inbox
risks.signal: Dwell on verification-requested page > 60s; no click on resend

steps.label: Account created and organization set up

interventions.content: Last time you signed in with {lastMethod}. Want to use that again?
interventions.goal: Restore continuity by reminding the user of their previous auth method.

risks.label: User forgot which auth method they used previously
risks.signal: Returning visitor; gap between sessions > 7 days; dwell on login page > 15s

steps.text: User lands on the login page.
User enters credentials or selects an OAuth provider.
System validates credentials and creates session.
User is redirected to their workspace survey list.

interventions.content: No pressure — you're on Pro for 14 days free. You can always switch later. Hit 'Build my first survey' to jump in.
interventions.goal: Collapse decision fatigue by reinforcing the trial is risk-free.

interventions.content: Most teams start with an NPS or CSAT template — they take under a minute to set up. Want me to walk you through it?
interventions.goal: Spotlight the single most valuable next action to break paralysis.

interventions.content: Try something like: 'I want to know how satisfied my customers are after onboarding.' The AI will turn it into a proper survey.
interventions.goal: Provide a concrete example to unblock the AI prompt input.

risks.label: User unsure which plan to pick; decision fatigue at trial screen

risks.label: User doesn't know what kind of survey to create first

risks.label: User doesn't know how to describe their survey to the AI

entryPages.text: View all surveys and create new one

interventions.content: Start simple: add one question that gets you the answer you need most. You can always add more later.
interventions.goal: Reduce overwhelm by focusing attention on the single next action.

interventions.content: Looks like something needs fixing before you can publish. Check the highlighted field — I can help if you're stuck.
interventions.goal: Direct user attention to the specific validation issue.

risks.signal: Dwell on editor > 3 min without adding a question; no interactions with panels

risks.label: Validation error prevents survey from going live

interventions.content: No responses yet? Share the survey link or connect the SDK to start collecting. Here's how to get your first response in under 5 minutes.
interventions.goal: Bridge the empty state by offering a concrete next step to get data flowing.

interventions.content: User is scanning data — this is normal analytical behavior. No intervention needed until they leave without taking any action.
interventions.goal: Respect the analytical moment; avoid interrupting data review.

interventions.content: You've hit your response limit for this month. Your surveys are paused — upgrade to Pro to keep collecting feedback without interruption.
interventions.goal: Connect the current friction (paused surveys) to its specific resolution (upgrade).

interventions.content: Payment didn't go through. You can try a different card, or contact us at hola@formbricks.com and we'll sort it out.
interventions.goal: Provide immediate recovery path for failed payment.
